salsa/Salsa-Regular.glyphs (gftools) ✎99.446% (sizeof(GPOS))
table value
sizeof(GPOS) 196B
total 99.447%
view source repository copy reproduction command
annotations
  • size-only GPOS gap: the source's kern lookup has `subtable;` breaks between glyph pairs, which reproduce the shipped binary's subtables. fea-rs honours them, one PairPos format 1 subtable per segment as shipped, keeping pairs that repeat across segments; feaLib merges a lookup's glyph pairs into one subtable, first rule winning, and applies breaks only to class pairs, the one place the FEA spec requires them (a break left over from the glyph pairs also splits feaLib's class pairs after their first rule). The positioning is the same. fea-rs already ignores such breaks in SinglePos (fontc#2308): https://github.com/googlefonts/fontc/pull/2329
  • (to add or change, manually edit annotations.json)

  • the Bellota Text instances swap 79 glyphs with their .ss01 forms through the 'Rename Glyphs' instance parameter: glyphsLib applies it when cutting the instance UFO, fontc --export ignores it, so outlines, advances and anchors differ: https://github.com/googlefonts/fontc/issues/2284
  • (to add or change, manually edit annotations.json)

annotations
  • default fvar instance: fontc reuses nameID 2/17; fontTools allocates a new ID because the FEA featureNames add Mac records that 2/17 lack (both valid)
  • several '# Automatic Code' markers for one feature (dist in bangla.fea and telugu-*.fea): ufo2ft inserts the generated kern/dist lookups at the first, fea-rs at the last
  • fontc runs propagateAnchors before decomposeTransformedComponents regardless of the source's filter order: rotated-component Ethiopic composites gain a top anchor: https://github.com/googlefonts/fontc/issues/2020
  • the new arabic-*.fea, included last, declares languagesystem arab after other features. ufo2ft inserts its generated abvm/blwm at telugu's blwm insertion marker, ahead of those statements, so feaLib doesn't register them for arab; fontc registers them for arab too
  • (to add or change, manually edit annotations.json)

satsuyako/Hina-Mincho/$VIRTUAL/google/fonts/ofl/hinamincho/config.yaml sources/Hina-Mincho.glyphs?7642eb499c (default) ✎
view source repository copy reproduction command
annotations
  • smart parts _part.kanji.nabebuta and _part.kanji.nogihen have a pole layer that is off-default on both hidari and migi. glyphsLib and fontc both model it as a hidari×migi corner and extrapolate the components' migi = 70000/100000 (axis 0-100), so fontmake's glyf overflows int16 while fontc silently clamps 35 glyphs to ±32767. Glyphs.app's export follows hidari alone and ignores migi (measured from the repo's TTF)

  • static-only family: Google Fonts ships statics and the masters aren't interpolation-compatible, but crater's default mode builds a variable font from any multi-master source, so both compilers fail: https://github.com/googlefonts/fontc/issues/1288

view source repository copy reproduction command
annotations
  • duplicate Glyphs 2 bracket layers: peso keeps a dated backup 'Bold [100] Nov 5 16, 16:11' next to 'Bold [100]' (the Italic also has two [100] layers on ampersand.sc), so glyphsLib makes peso.BRACKET.varAlt01 twice and fontc finds two outlines for one location
  • static-only family: Google Fonts ships statics and the masters aren't interpolation-compatible, but crater's default mode builds a variable font from any multi-master source, so both compilers fail: https://github.com/googlefonts/fontc/issues/1288
  • (to add or change, manually edit annotations.json)

view source repository copy reproduction command
annotations
  • static-only family: Google Fonts ships statics and the masters aren't interpolation-compatible, but crater's default mode builds a variable font from any multi-master source, so both compilers fail: https://github.com/googlefonts/fontc/issues/1288
  • duplicate Glyphs 2 bracket layers: peso keeps a dated backup 'Bold [100] Nov 5 16, 16:11' next to 'Bold [100]' (the Italic also has two [100] layers on ampersand.sc), so glyphsLib makes peso.BRACKET.varAlt01 twice and fontc finds two outlines for one location
  • (to add or change, manually edit annotations.json)

annotations
  • static-only family: Google Fonts ships statics and the masters aren't interpolation-compatible, but crater's default mode builds a variable font from any multi-master source, so both compilers fail: https://github.com/googlefonts/fontc/issues/1288
  • duplicate Glyphs 2 bracket layers: peso keeps a dated backup 'Bold [100] Nov 5 16, 16:11' next to 'Bold [100]' (the Italic also has two [100] layers on ampersand.sc), so glyphsLib makes peso.BRACKET.varAlt01 twice and fontc finds two outlines for one location
  • (to add or change, manually edit annotations.json)

annotations
  • static-only family: Google Fonts ships statics and the masters aren't interpolation-compatible, but crater's default mode builds a variable font from any multi-master source, so both compilers fail: https://github.com/googlefonts/fontc/issues/1288
  • duplicate Glyphs 2 bracket layers: peso keeps a dated backup 'Bold [100] Nov 5 16, 16:11' next to 'Bold [100]' (the Italic also has two [100] layers on ampersand.sc), so glyphsLib makes peso.BRACKET.varAlt01 twice and fontc finds two outlines for one location
  • (to add or change, manually edit annotations.json)

annotations
  • gcircumflex and gmacron use different components in the 144pt Black masters (swapped order, spacing circumflex/macron instead of the combining marks), so the masters aren't interpolation-compatible; the shipped 2020 VF silently has no gvar for them: https://github.com/undercasetype/Fraunces/pull/275
  • norad can't parse the designspace: stray <labelname> elements sit between <axis> elements directly inside <axes>, which serde reports as 'duplicate field axis'; fontTools ignores them

xotypeco/big_shoulders/Big-Shoulders-Inline/sources/config.yml BigShouldersInline.glyphs?8ba99c9e34 (gftools) ✎
view source repository copy reproduction command
annotations
  • gftools 0.10.7 leaves hidden axes out of the VF filename (gftools#1244). The source hides opsz (masters at 10 and 72), so the VF is built as X[wght].ttf, but the config's stat is keyed by X[opsz,wght].ttf, the name google/fonts ships from this config, so gftools-gen-stat fails on both sides. gftools' maintainers call it a new policy, so the config needs updating: https://github.com/googlefonts/gftools/issues/1247

view source repository copy reproduction command
annotations
  • the instance lies outside the masters' weight range (Inknut Antiqua Light at 0 vs 100-900, Arya Regular at 85 vs 100-130, Sintony Light at 50 vs 72-152); glyphsLib 6.16 bounds the axis at the masters, so `fontmake -i` writes no UFO for it and gftools' fontmake build fails on the missing file: https://github.com/googlefonts/glyphsLib/pull/1197
  • the export sits between masters, and crater's gftools mode builds every static with `fontc --export` (--experimental-fontc-strict); fontc doesn't interpolate static instances, so it fails by design: https://github.com/googlefonts/fontc/pull/2299
  • (to add or change, manually edit annotations.json)

the export sits between masters, and crater's gftools mode builds every static with `fontc --export` (--experimental-fontc-strict); fontc doesn't interpolate static instances, so it fails by design; fontmake fails too, for a separate reason given in each target's annotation (https://github.com/googlefonts/fontc/pull/2299)

annotations
  • the export sits between masters, and crater's gftools mode builds every static with `fontc --export` (--experimental-fontc-strict); fontc doesn't interpolate static instances, so it fails by design: https://github.com/googlefonts/fontc/pull/2299
  • Cabin.glyphs puts the normal width at design 0 and condensed at 100, so glyphsLib's wdth mapping decreases (75→100, 100→0); fontTools rejects it ('Invalid axis values ... 100, 0, 0') when gftools cuts the static with `fontmake -i`: https://github.com/impallari/Cabin/issues/16

view source repository copy reproduction command
annotations
  • fontmake fails because fontmetrics has contours in the default Regular master (179) but an empty layer in the Bold master (344): glyphsLib 6.17.0 marks that layer explicitly empty (glyphsLib#1219) and ufo2ft 3.11.0 keeps it as a master, so the Medium (242) and Bold (282) instances between the two can't interpolate it ('list index out of range'). Before, ufo2ft treated the empty layer as sparse and fontmake went on to fail on the repeated `languagesystem deva dflt`: https://github.com/googlefonts/ufo2ft/pull/1018
  • the export sits between masters, and crater's gftools mode builds every static with `fontc --export` (--experimental-fontc-strict); fontc doesn't interpolate static instances, so it fails by design: https://github.com/googlefonts/fontc/pull/2299
  • (to add or change, manually edit annotations.json)

the export sits between masters, and crater's gftools mode builds every static with `fontc --export` (--experimental-fontc-strict); fontc doesn't interpolate static instances, so it fails by design; fontmake fails too, for a separate reason given in each target's annotation (https://github.com/googlefonts/fontc/pull/2299)

annotations
  • the export sits between masters, and crater's gftools mode builds every static with `fontc --export` (--experimental-fontc-strict); fontc doesn't interpolate static instances, so it fails by design: https://github.com/googlefonts/fontc/pull/2299
